title: Connect verb gesture lifecycle (draw_begin/draw_move/draw_end/draw_cancel) has zero test coverage — the E1.3 cancel-elsewhere error path is unverified
detail: The slice's primary verb is a state machine whose cancel-elsewhere, sky-release-cancel, self-snap-guard, preview-follow and focus-loss paths (E1.3 story + frozen I/O matrix 'Cancel' row) are never exercised; only the happy-path commit is tested via connect_programmatic.
recommended_fix: Add headless controller tests against the instantiated main scene: unproject node screen positions, drive draw_begin/draw_move/draw_end; assert commit on snap, no pipe + hidden preview on empty-surface and sky release, and draw_cancel dropping the gesture.

title: InputRouter integration path untested — only the pure classify() rule is pinned; _pick physics query, mode transitions and focus-loss cancel have no tests
detail: A regressed collision mask (0b11), missing collide_with_areas, or wrong node collision layer would break draw-vs-orbit disambiguation in-game while the classify() unit test stays green; the focus-loss cancel (_notification) is also unverified.
recommended_fix: Add an integration test that ray-casts through the real scene (planet body layer 1, node Area3D layer 2) asserting _begin routes node hits to DRAW and empty hits to ORBIT, plus a focus-out notification emitting gesture_cancelled.

title: E1.5 node orientation and collision setup untested — suite asserts only node count and wedge spread
detail: Buildings oriented to the surface normal is E1.5's stated behavior, and the layer-2 Area3D is what makes draw-disambiguation possible; a flipped basis or wrong layer would be invisible to the current suite.
recommended_fix: Assert per-site basis.y aligns with surface_pos.normalized() (dot ≈ 1), collision_layer == 2, and a SphereShape3D hitbox exists; also assert pairwise min angular separation from WorldSeed.

title: main.gd signal wiring (router → rig/controller) never asserted — scene instantiation passes even if a connect() silently fails
detail: Godot connect() failures are non-fatal push_errors; the boot check in test_no_sim would stay green with the entire input grammar unwired, and no test emits a router signal to verify the chain.
recommended_fix: In test_no_sim assert is_connected() for each of the six wirings, or emit router.gesture_ended/orbit_moved and observe controller/rig state change.

title: Damped easing (_process lerp) untested — camera tests bypass it by calling _apply_pose directly
evidence:
func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	var k := 1.0 - exp(-EASE_RATE * delta)
	_azimuth = lerp_angle(_azimuth, _target_azimuth, k)
	_latitude = lerpf(_latitude, _target_latitude, k)
	_distance = lerpf(_distance, _target_distance, k)
	_apply_pose(_azimuth, _latitude, _distance)

(tests/test_camera.gd poses the rig via `_rig._apply_pose(_rig._target_azimuth, _rig._target_latitude, 14.0)` at lines 32, 45, 49, 69 — never advancing _process.)
detail: E1.2's 'damped easing' behavior (convergence to ladder stops, no overshoot/drift) is unverified; the no-roll guarantee is only pinned at discrete poses, not during eased motion. Low risk — tuning-level.
recommended_fix: Add a test that steps _process with fixed deltas after a zoom()/orbit() and asserts monotone convergence of _distance to the stop and no-roll at intermediate poses.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0 (the 5 epic test contracts) = 100%: snap-intent, geodesic validity/no-tunneling, classify rule, camera no-roll, no-sim all traced to checks in 4 suites (51 checks). P1 story-level behaviors ≈ 70%: gesture lifecycle (cancel/sky-release/preview/focus-loss), pick integration, node orientation, wiring, easing all NONE. Overall ≈ 75%. Gate FAIL on P1 < 80%.
recommended_fix: Implement the controller gesture-lifecycle tests and the input-router integration test (findings 1–2); that alone lifts P1 above 90% and the gate to PASS.
